qualifier: downstream of IGF signalling, driving apoptosis and muscle atrophy
name: IGF–AKT control of FOXO-driven apoptosis and atrophy
rationale: Members centre on AKT phosphorylation, acetylation and nuclear exclusion of FOXO factors with their IGF/insulin-like inputs and cell-death, neuronal-apoptosis and muscle-atrophy outputs, whereas confusables are built around mTORC1/p53 metabolism, NFE2L2 antioxidant control or HSF1 heat shock.

qualifier: during replication and repair
name: DNA topology remodelling during replication and repair
rationale: Members concern changes in DNA geometry and topology, fork reversal, protein-DNA complex disassembly and regulation of strand elongation, NER and damage-linked telomere maintenance, distinguishing it from the chromatin/ADP-ribosylation and telomere-recombination confusables.

qualifier: controlling inflammatory cytokine production (IL-1, IL-6, IL-10, IL-12, TNF)
name: Regulation of Toll-like receptor signalling and inflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members are positive and negative regulators of TLR2/3/4, MyD88/TRIF, IL-1 and CD40 signalling and of IL-1, IL-6, IL-10, IL-12 and TNF production, whereas confusables emphasise TAK1/IKK intermediates, inflammasomes and LPS detection, or T-cell and NF-kB suppression.

qualifier: positive regulation, endothelial proliferation and branching
name: Promotion of sprouting angiogenesis and endothelial proliferation
rationale: All members are positive regulators of angiogenic sprouting, endothelial proliferation, migration and vessel branching, while confusables are dominated by negative regulation of angiogenesis and VEGF/FGF signalling.

qualifier: proline, glutamine-family and glycine–glyoxylate
name: Proline, glutamine-family and glycine–glyoxylate amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members cover general alpha-amino acid metabolism anchored by proline synthesis and catabolism, glutamine-family metabolism and glycine/glyoxylate synthesis, separating it from serine/vitamin B6, aromatic amino acid and histidine/threonine confusables.

qualifier: end processing, HR/NHEJ/SSA choice and BRCA1–BRCA2–PALB2 defects
name: Double-strand break end processing, repair and BRCA–PALB2 defects
rationale: Members span DSB sensing, end resection, homologous recombination, classical and alternative end joining and single-strand annealing plus disease variants of BRCA1, BARD1, BRCA2 and PALB2, whereas confusables add cross-link repair or ADP-ribosylation and chromatin remodelling.

core: DNA replication origin licensing and initiation
qualifier: under E2F transcriptional and ATR checkpoint control
name: E2F-controlled origin licensing and DNA replication initiation
rationale: Members describe ORC/CDC6 pre-replicative complex assembly and activation, replication initiation and its checkpoint/ATR control together with E2F regulation, while confusables are broader cell-cycle and G1/S transcription modules or intra-S damage checkpoints.

Members are unrelated transcription-module gene sets (unknown and SREBF1 promoter motifs, glucocorticoid receptor targets, a megakaryocyte-platelet module and an adhesion-signalling module) with no shared biological process.

qualifier: Reelin signalling
name: Reelin signalling in dendrite, spine and synapse maturation
rationale: Members combine Reelin signalling with positive regulation of dendrite development, spine morphogenesis and maintenance, synapse maturation and plasticity, distinguishing it from amyloid-beta, NMDAR-downstream and postsynaptic actin confusables.

qualifier: typical RHOA/B/C, CDC42, RHOG, RHOD, RHOJ with formin activation
name: Typical RHO and CDC42 GTPase cycles with formin activation
rationale: Members are the GTPase cycles of RHOA/B/C, CDC42, RHOD, RHOG and RHOJ plus formin activation and G-beta-gamma to CDC42 signalling, whereas confusables contain the atypical RHOU/RHOV/RND, RHOF or IQGAP branches.

qualifier: via ESCRT/multivesicular body machinery
name: ESCRT-dependent viral budding and release
rationale: All members concern enveloped virus budding and non-lytic release, including HIV budding and MVB sorting, separating it from ESCRT confusables in abscission and nuclear envelope sealing and from HIV entry/Nef confusables.

qualifier: inherited defects causing herpes simplex encephalitis
name: TLR3–TBK1–IRF3 signalling and herpes simplex encephalitis deficiencies
rationale: Members cover endosomal TLR trafficking, TBK1/IKKe activation of IRF3/IRF7 and TLR3, UNC93B1, TRAF3 and TICAM1 deficiencies in HSE, whereas confusables are type I interferon responses, cytosolic sensors or TLR7/8/9 signalling.

qualifier: microvilli/brush border, tight junctions and polarised protein sorting
name: Epithelial apical surface, brush border and polarised protein sorting
rationale: Members concern microvillus and brush-border assembly, tight junctions and paracellular transport, apical/raft protein localisation and Golgi-to-membrane delivery, while confusables centre on CFTR, podocytes, pancreatic ducts or bile lipid transport.

qualifier: entry, transport and release
name: Regulation of viral entry, transport and release
rationale: Members are generic host and symbiont regulation of viral entry, virus transport and release, lacking the virus-specific (Dengue, RSV, influenza) entry modules and genome-replication terms of the confusables.

qualifier: ephrin and L1 with RAC1 activation and fasciculation
name: Ephrin and L1 signalling in axon guidance and fasciculation
rationale: Members are ephrin receptor signalling and repulsion, L1 signalling and recycling, DCC attraction, RAC1 activation and axonal fasciculation, whereas confusables are dominated by netrin repulsion, ROBO-SLIT or RHO GTPase filopodium control.

qualifier: endosome-to-TGN and COPI-independent recycling
name: Endosome-to-trans-Golgi retrograde transport and Golgi retention
rationale: Members describe retrograde endosome-to-TGN traffic, COPI-independent Golgi-to-ER return, Golgi retention and TGN lysosomal vesicle biogenesis, distinguishing it from anterograde Golgi-to-endosome/lysosome and COPI-vesicle confusables.

qualifier: respiratory chain assembly, protein import and iron-sulfur biogenesis
name: Mitochondrial respiratory chain assembly, protein import and iron–sulfur biogenesis
rationale: Members span electron transport and ATP synthesis, complex I/III/IV/ATP synthase assembly, mitochondrial protein import and processing, cristae and Fe-S cluster assembly, while confusables add mitochondrial RNA import, translation or heme/ubiquinol synthesis.

qualifier: mesodermal migration and lateral plate morphogenesis
name: Mesendoderm formation, mesodermal migration and lateral plate morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern germ-layer formation, mesendoderm and mesodermal cell migration and lateral plate derivatives (pericardium, heart, hindgut), whereas confusables emphasise primitive streak, definitive endoderm or second heart field cardiogenesis.

qualifier: calcium-triggered fusion and spontaneous release
name: Regulation of calcium-triggered synaptic vesicle fusion and release
rationale: Members regulate calcium-dependent neurotransmitter exocytosis, vesicle fusion at the active zone, spontaneous release and short-term potentiation, while confusables carry docking/priming, transmitter-specific release cycles or presynaptic calcium and GABA/glutamate secretion.

qualifier: growth hormone JAK-STAT and thyroid hormone action
name: Growth hormone and thyroid hormone control of somatic growth
rationale: Members combine growth hormone receptor JAK-STAT signalling, IGF receptor potentiation and organismal growth with thyroid hormone transport, activity and response, distinguishing it from thyroid-receptor, leptin/prolactin and glucagon/somatostatin confusables.

qualifier: glutamate, glutamine, alanine and aspartate linked to gluconeogenesis
name: Glutamate-centred amino acid nitrogen metabolism and gluconeogenesis
rationale: Members cover glutamate, glutamine, alanine, aspartate and asparagine metabolism, oxaloacetate, nitrogen utilisation and gluconeogenesis, whereas confusables involve proline/glycine metabolism, glycine conjugation or the TCA cycle.

qualifier: iodide uptake, selenium and PAPS-dependent sulfonation
name: Iodide, selenium and sulfonation in thyroid hormone synthesis and metabolism
rationale: Members link iodide transport and SLC5A5 defects, H2O2 regulation and thyroid hormone generation and activity with selenide formation and PAPS synthesis and sulfonation, distinguishing it from ROS, selenocysteine, SLC26 anion-exchange and thyroid-receptor confusables.

core: Visceral smooth muscle contraction and relaxation
qualifier: tachykinin signalling in urogenital and reproductive function
name: Tachykinin signalling and urogenital, reproductive smooth muscle contraction
rationale: Members combine tachykinin receptor signalling and smooth muscle contraction/relaxation with micturition, uterine contraction, parturition, erection and insemination, whereas confusables centre on gastrointestinal motility, adrenergic vascular tone or GnRH/PLC signalling.

qualifier: proximal-distal segment patterning from comma- and S-shaped bodies
name: Proximal–distal nephron patterning from comma- and S-shaped bodies
rationale: Members concern comma- and S-shaped body morphogenesis and nephron segment patterning into loop of Henle, distal tubule and collecting duct, distinguishing it from ureteric bud, nephric duct and renal vesicle/MET confusables.

qualifier: with cardiomyocyte fate specification
name: Cardiac conduction system and cardiomyocyte fate specification
rationale: Members are sinoatrial node, atrioventricular node and canal and His-Purkinje development plus cardiomyocyte fate commitment and cardioblast differentiation, whereas confusables cover conduction physiology or chamber, septum and second heart field morphogenesis.
